About • Collections • Blog • Compare • Privacy Policy • Terms of Service • Submit a pedal • © 2026 PedalFilter Clear Compare ( 0 ) Back Home Fjord Fuzz Berserk Back to results Fjord Fuzz Berserk Fuzz Fuzz Face/Tone Bender hybrid with weird-biased preamp. S8050 silicon transistors, biased to 6.66V. Fuzz combining Fuzz Face/Tone Bender circuits with single-transistor preamp stage. 2x S8050 (J3Y) silicon transistors. Biased to 6.66V factory setting - adjustable internally (3V for sputtery, 4.5-5V for vintage correct). Controls: Volume, Gain, Bias, Thickness. Preamp eliminates buffer/wah compatibility issues of original circuits. Incandenza relay bypass. Inherently noisy circuit type - use clean, high-quality power. 9V DC, 200mA recommended.
